surface_name: Webhook node test and production URLs
title: n8n webhook returns 404 'The requested webhook is not registered' on the second call
symptoms: 404 The requested webhook "POST my-path" is not registered.
Test URL works once after Listen for test event, then fails
Production URL calls run but nothing shows on the canvas
cause: The webhook-test URL is registered only while the editor is listening and accepts a single call. The production URL exists only while the workflow is published or active, and its runs appear only in the Executions list.
fix: Point external services at the production URL, publish the workflow, and read results in the Executions tab. Use the test URL only for one manual call at a time.
apply:
https://n8n.example.com/webhook/my-path      # production, needs the workflow published
https://n8n.example.com/webhook-test/my-path # one call after Listen for test event
affected: n8n 1.x and 2.x self-hosted and Cloud, as of 2026-10
